name: Adaptive Brain
install:
set -euo pipefail
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive corepack pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
python3 -m pip install --user graphifyy
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/graphify" /usr/local/bin/graphify
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/graphify-mcp" /usr/local/bin/graphify-mcp
if ! dpkg -s obsidian >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL -o /tmp/obsidian_1.13.7_amd64.deb https://github.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-releases/releases/download/v1.13.7/obsidian_1.13.7_amd64.deb
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y /tmp/obsidian_1.13.7_amd64.deb
fi
if ! command -v claude-mem >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  CI=true CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false npx --yes claude-mem install --no-auto-start
  sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/claude-mem" /usr/local/bin/claude-mem
fi
start:
set -euo pipefail
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:4173/coach.html; then exit 0; fi
exec python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory apps/coach
